decisions.reason: A flagship transactional email service that extends the firm's core messaging expertise, backed by its own R&D, so it can interpret results and keep improving the product.
Managed capture builds on the firm's document workflow know-how, has a reported customer adoption, and fits its direction toward digital business processes.
Email and fax conversion sits squarely within the firm's established messaging infrastructure, so it is cheap to maintain and easy to assimilate.
A fax delivery feature close to the core fax business that regulated customers still rely on, although fax decline makes it somewhat more exposed.
Sandbox threat protection strengthens the firm's email security portfolio, where its related knowledge and R&D allow continuous improvement, even though the multi-engine scanner was dropped.
